message.content: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.treelinereview.com/gearreviews/camping-outdoor-blankets","version_id":"21170f66f8d79e6d047f2ae7e19207116c5accd7b06e05d7a10f3accdcf682a5","decision":"accept","reason":"Under Relevance, Credibility, and Freshness and novelty, this updated guide supplies transferable sleep-system and cold-weather evidence: timed 0.5-liter leakage tests, Backcountry Blanket use in freezing temperatures and 35 mph winds, and the Original Puffy's insufficient warmth on a night in the 40s.
